title: Brian Burns: I'm kinda looking at this as my defense

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Brian Burns: I'm kinda looking at this as my defense
sources.description: Giants edge rusher Brian Burns said in mid-April that he did not want to play "this season or any other season" without Dexter Lawrence, but that didn't stop the team from trading Lawrence to the Bengals a short time later.
